t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Work out which basket gives more, then keep on choosing that basket until there's no mushrooms left then switch. Red basket is linked to red, purple and brown gnomes.

vb_textbox.text: There are two baskets, red and yellow.  One will give you more for a while, then the supply will run down and the other will be better.  Work out which one is giving more mushrooms, and keep choosing that one until you have a few goes in a row with only 1 or 0 mushrooms, then switch to the other basket.  The supply will keep switching throughout the game.  The red basket is linked to the red, purple, brown and pink gnomes.  The yellow basket is linked to the yellow, orange, blue and green gnomes.
